plan.hint: Search an address, or long-press the map (right-click on PC) to drop a pin.
plan.morePhoton: Not found? Also search venues and abroad (Photon)
drive.rerouteFailed: Reroute failed — follow the old route, retrying soon.
drive.lockedMsg: Above 10 km/h, planning and settings are locked.
drive.noVoice: No English voice found on this device — install one in system settings.
sim.title: Simulator
gig.empty: No gigs yet. Add one with a venue, date and load-in time.
gig.needVenue: Pick a venue with an address to calculate the drive time.
gig.notifyNote: Reminders (15 min before and at leave-by) work while the app is open. Background notifications on iPhone arrive in phase 6.
gig.title: Name
share.copied: ETA message copied — paste it in WhatsApp.
share.failed: Sharing isn't available on this device.
tow.estimated: partly estimated — fill in sizes in Settings
tow.verify: Verify these caps yourself for your combination (licence, towbar registration, trailer). Defaults: 90 / 80 / 50.
tow.voice.sharp: Caution, sharp turn with the trailer.
tow.voice.narrow: Caution, narrow road with the trailer.
tow.voice.descent: Caution, steep descent with the trailer.
venue.name: Name
venue.pickDoorHint: Tap the map where the load-in door is.
venue.pickParkingHint: Tap the map where the trailer can park.
handoff.title: Hand over to another device
handoff.loaded: Route loaded — same stops, options and trailer.
handoff.badCode: Not a valid Funqtion route QR
handoff.gpxSimplified: GPX had a long track — only its start and end were used as stops.
handoff.qrHint: Scan with Funqtion Maps on the other device (Plan → Scan QR).
phev.title: Plug-in hybrid
phev.showZones: Show low-emission zones on the map
phev.zonesNote: 22 Dutch low-emission zones from OpenStreetMap (ODbL). Rules differ per city and vehicle — check milieuzones.nl. Petrol PHEVs are usually allowed.
phev.needKey: Open Charge Map needs a free API key (openchargemap.org → My Profile). Paste it below or set VITE_OCM_KEY in .env.
phev.voice.evZone: Tip: switch to EV mode for the low-emission zone.
phev.voice.evUrban: Tip: switch to EV mode, you're entering a built-up area.
offline.title: Offline map
offline.hint: Build a region (e.g. Noord-Brabant) with planetiler — see README. Map labels already ship offline.
offline.routeCache: Recently computed routes and the active route are kept when signal drops.
stats.heatmapHint: The map shows every road driven this season — the more often, the brighter.
voice.title: Voice
voice.piperHint: Natural-sounding Dutch voice that runs fully on the device — offline too, after a one-time download. Instructions are pre-rendered, so there's no delay.
voice.systemHint: The Windows or iOS voice. Instant and no download, but quality varies per device.
voice.piperNlOnly: Piper voices are Dutch; with English selected the system voice is used.
voice.untilDownloaded: Until you download a voice, the system voice speaks the instructions.
voice.piperCredits: Piper (MIT) · voices: mls (CC BY 4.0), Nathalie/RDH — open voice data via Hugging Face.
voice.betterSystem: Tip: on iPhone, download an Enhanced voice — Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → Voices. On Windows: Settings → Time & language → Speech → add a voice.
check.ok: This combination is within the limits you entered.
check.disclaimer: Indication based on your input — not legal advice. Check your registration and licence.
check.overTow: Trailer ({mass} kg) exceeds the car's towing capacity ({cap} kg).
check.unbraked750: An unbraked trailer may weigh at most 750 kg ({mass} kg entered).
check.noTrailerMass: Enter the trailer weight for the towing check.
check.noTowCap: Enter the car's max towing weight (registration document).
check.licenceUnknown: Enter the car's max permitted mass to check your licence.
check.licence: With licence {licence} the combination may be at most {limit} kg; it is {combo} kg. You need BE (or code 96).
check.be3500: Even with BE the trailer may be at most 3500 kg ({mass} kg).
vehicle.tapToFill: tap to fill in all details
guide.title: Guidance
guide.level: How much does the voice tell you?
guide.level.kort: Only turns and critical warnings (too low clearance).
guide.level.normaal: Turns with traffic lights and exit numbers, speed cameras, zones, limit changes, level crossings and tolls.
guide.level.uitgebreid: Plus zebra crossings, cycle lanes/paths when turning, one-way streets, unsignalled junctions, stop signs and tunnels.
guide.level.max: Everything, including full zone explanations, signalled junctions, bridges, crossings, bumps, unpaved roads and lanes.
guide.leadHint: At higher speeds the app announces earlier automatically.
map.title: Map & display
map.routeDetailsHint: cameras, traffic lights, zebra crossings, level crossings, bumps, signs, clearances
map.poisHint: fuel, parking, hospital, police, toilets, food
ins.title: For
ins.noCost: Enter consumption and prices for a cost estimate.
ins.rangeOk: You'll make it on what's in the tank/battery.
ins.rangeLow: Probably not enough fuel/charge for this trip!
ins.heightHint: low bridges and tunnels are avoided where OSM knows the clearance
ins.noHeight: Enter your car's height to avoid low bridges.
